messages:
From: Ellis Monroe <ellis@stargatefinance.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: John Peters <john.peters@stargatefinance.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff - security ops items

Hi Irene —

Thanks again for the demo last week. We want to lock the MAP sprint and the close timeline on our side; two quick asks from procurement and security before we commit: 1) a copy of your latest SOC 2 report (or an executive summary), 2) a completed SIG/CAIQ CSV snapshot we can run through our intake tool, and 3) any redlines you anticipate in the DPA so our legal team can prep.

Our timeline: security acceptance by 10/20, legal signoff by 10/25, go/no-go by 10/27. If we can get artifacts by next week, we’ll keep to that cadence.

Can you confirm owners and whether Redwood can host an evidence-staging folder for us?

Thanks —
Ellis Monroe
Head of Platform Security
Stargate Finance

Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, John Peters <john.peters@stargatefinance.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Sep 2026 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Shared accountability: MAP sprint & security ops checklist

Hi Ellis —

Appreciate the clear timeline. Short answers up front: yes, we will host an evidence-staging Google Drive for Stargate; owners below. We’ll aim to get the SOC 2 executive summary and CAIQ CSV by next Tuesday (10/06). DPA redlines: legal will produce a Redline + rationale doc by 10/08.

Owners and deliverables (tentative):
- SOC 2 executive summary / evidence pointers — Naomi Feldman (naomi.feldman@redwood.ai)
- CAIQ / SIG snapshot (CSV) — Marcus Lin (marcus.lin@redwood.ai)
- DPA redline + comments — Jordan Blake (jordan.blake@redwood.ai) and Legal
- Evidence staging folder + access provisioning — Irene Choi (me)

Operational notes and ask for you: please add the security point-of-contact for evidence intake (SPOC) in the map spreadsheet and confirm whether you require encrypted-at-rest only or also region-bound storage. Our default is multi-region with optional EU residency for accounts that require it.

I’ll attach the SOC 2 summary and CAIQ CSV when ready and create the Drive link. Jordan / Marcus / Naomi — can you confirm ETA against the customer timeline? If there are material gaps we should propose an adjustment to the 10/20 acceptance date now.

—
Irene Choi
Head, Customer Security Ops
Redwood Inference

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 01 Oct 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: MAP sprint owners + deliverable checklist (Stargate)

Team —

Recap / action items for our MAP sprint with Stargate (security acceptance target 2026-10-20). Please reply inline with a hard ETA. We will copy final artifacts to the shared Drive and notify Ellis.

1) SOC 2 executive summary + evidence map (Naomi) — include location of each control artifact (Drive path or internal ticket). ETA?
2) CAIQ/SIG CSV (Marcus) — populate columns they use; include control-level notes for any partially met items. ETA?
3) DPA redlines (Jordan + Legal) — mark any residency clauses and retention carve-outs; include suggested fallback language for archival access. ETA?
4) Evidence staging folder + ACLs (Irene) — I’ll provision folder and send DocuSign link if they request a signed addendum for access.

Notes: a) If SOC 2 evidence for a control is under NDA with a vendor, flag it and provide a redacted summary rather than full artifact. b) Stargate asked specifically about data retention windows for embeddings and logs — they want a 90/365/ever breakdown per dataset. Prepare the retention table format they can attach to the MAP. c) We should surface any feature-level limitations (hosted vs private) that could affect acceptance criteria (latency, region residency).

Jordan — please prioritize DPA clauses around customer-origin data residency and subprocessor list; I’ll include the default KMS/HSM options we support. Marcus / Naomi — let me know if you need a stub CAIQ template to speed completion.

Thanks —
Irene

From: Ellis Monroe <ellis@stargatefinance.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: John Peters <john.peters@stargatefinance.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 16:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Shared accountability: MAP sprint & security ops checklist

Irene / team —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and owner list. Confirming: SPOC for evidence intake will be me (ellis@stargatefinance.com) and John Peters on procurement. We need the SOC 2 exec summary + CAIQ CSV by COB Tue 10/06 to stay on our 10/20 security acceptance milestone. If DPA redlines arrive by 10/08, our legal will slot a review the week of 10/12 and circle back with any counterpoints by 10/18.

On retention: yes, please include the 90/365/ever table — we’ll attach it to the MAP and share retention carveouts on our side where necessary. For storage residency: we require EU-residency option for any EU customer data; we’ll flag which datasets during intake.

We received the initial MAP workbook you attached earlier and updated the intake tab with our security SPOC. I’ll upload a short procurement checklist to the Drive tonight. Can you share the Drive link and a DocuSign access addendum if you prefer that route for evidence access?

Looking forward to Naomis/Marcus/Jordan’s notes tomorrow.

Best,
Ellis
Head of Platform Security
Stargate Finance
